source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the mode (PDF 192-194).

blocks.text: Mode woh qeemat ya qeematein hain jo data mein sab se zyada aati hain. Hayatiyat mein yeh sample ki sab se aam khasiyat dikhata hai, jaise paude par phoolon ki sab se aam tadaad, beej ka sab se aam size ya sab se aam wazan. Ungrouped data ke liye formula nahi: mode bas sab se zyada aane wali qeemat hai.

Paudon ki unchaiyan: 50, 60, 50, 55, 50, 65, 60, 70, 55 aur 50 cm. Tarteeb: 50, 50, 50, 50, 55, 55, 60, 60, 65, 70. Frequencies: 50 chaar baar, 55 do baar, 60 do baar, 65 aik baar aur 70 aik baar, is liye mode 50 cm hai.

Grouped data ke liye mode = l + [(fm - f1) / ((fm - f1) + (fm - f2))] x h, jahan l modal class ki nichli had, fm us ki frequency, f1 aur f2 us se pehle aur baad ki classes ki frequencies, aur h class ki chaurai hai.

blocks.caption: Chiriya ghar ke janwaron ke wazan (kitab ka table)

blocks.explanation: 7, jo teen baar aata hai, kisi bhi doosri qeemat se zyada.

items: Mode = sab se zyada aane wali qeemat (paude: 50 cm).
Grouped mode = l + [(fm - f1) / ((fm - f1) + (fm - f2))] x h (janwar: 34.29 kg).
